insightsPage.description: You have an evaluation report based on your own sales conversation. This report contains the most important points of attention and improvements that can help you in your next conversations.

resistancesSection.resistanceTrue: You just said a whole team for a customer. That will cost something.
resistancesSection.resistanceFalse: Those we are doing business with now, that is fine. And of course we have experience with that from the past.
resistancesSection.responseTrue: That is not so bad. That is not so bad. It only yields.
resistancesSection.responseFalse: Yes, how do you say that? Innovation or at least looking around a bit more broadly is not wrong, I think.
resistancesSection.explanationTrue: The seller responds with a defense instead of a question. It would have been better to ask, for example, what the customer bases this assumption on or what their expectations are for costs and revenues.
resistancesSection.explanationFalse: The salesperson acknowledges the customer's current situation without directly attacking or defending it, and offers potential added value by indicating the importance of innovation and a broader view.

customerTypeSection.theDominantDescription: Always wants to win and be the best and is communicatively strong and convincing. Talks a lot about his success. Is motivated by ego-stroking matters.
customerTypeSection.theRationalDescription: Looks at details and facts and focuses on the clear process. Wants to know what the result will be. Thinks logically and is introverted. Is motivated by a good return on investment.
customerTypeSection.theSafeDescription: Avoids risks because the green person prefers to avoid confrontations. Is a team player and likes to serve others but within the agreements made to avoid mistakes and disappointing people. Is motivated by confirmation.
customerTypeSection.theEnthusiasticDescription: Loves new things and likes to take on challenges, but it should not be too complicated because then the yellow person loses interest. Is extroverted and likes conviviality. Is motivated by comfort.
